description: Fix Hockrow H-tier Description pointing at the Title loc-key — CIG bug (observed 4.7.18x): Hockrow_BlackBoxRecovery_{Stanton,Nyx}_Hard have Description=@blackbox_recover_title_H_001 where every other tier uses Description=@blackbox_recover_desc_H_001. Splits blackbox_recover_title_H_001 into two desc_key buckets (one with no BP pool) which causes the [BP?] tag to be suppressed by the _every_desc_has_some_bp safety check, even though the BitZeros H-tier does award a pool.
